title: 归来 (The Return)
style: The target video is a photorealistic live-action Chinese vertical short drama in 9:16 with cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, a 50mm-equivalent lens look, warm tungsten lamp key light against a cool blue night skyline, subtle film grain, and finely detailed faces with natural skin texture.

linxia.name: Lin Xia
linxia.look: a 28-year-old Chinese woman with an oval face, softly arched brows, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes with long curled eyelashes, a small beauty mark under her left eye, refined makeup with soft brown eyeshadow, thin eyeliner and a muted rose-red lip, long wavy dark-brown hair falling past her shoulders with a side part on the right, wearing a deep-red satin slip evening gown with thin straps and small pearl stud earrings.
linxia.keep: beauty mark under the left eye, long wavy dark-brown hair with the right side part, rose-red lip makeup, deep-red satin slip gown and pearl stud earrings
linxia.face_detail: long curled eyelashes, a small beauty mark under the left eye, fine skin texture with a natural sheen, soft brown eyeshadow and a muted rose-red lip.
linxia.voice_en: in a warm, slightly low female voice
linxia.voice_design: 二十八岁左右的成年女性，音色温暖、略偏低沉，普通话标准，语速中等偏慢，压抑着愤怒与委屈，尾音带一点颤抖。
linxia.voice_sample: 我等了你整整三年，每天晚上都站在这扇窗前，看着这座城市的灯一盏一盏地熄灭。
linxia.hair: long wavy dark-brown hair falling past the shoulders with a side part on her right, worn loose
linxia.costume: a deep-red satin slip evening gown with thin straps, ankle length, black pointed-toe high heels, small pearl stud earrings, no other jewellery

luchen.name: Lu Chen
luchen.look: a 32-year-old Chinese man with a lean face, a sharp jawline, straight thick brows, narrow dark eyes, a thin pale diagonal scar across his left eyebrow, short black hair neatly swept back, clearly visible light stubble on his jaw and upper lip, wearing a black two-piece suit over a white shirt with an open collar and no tie.
luchen.keep: thin scar across the left eyebrow, swept-back short black hair, light stubble, black suit and open-collar white shirt
luchen.face_detail: a thin pale thin scar across the left eyebrow, light stubble, fine skin texture, and dark eyes catching a small lamp highlight.
luchen.voice_en: in a deep, calm male voice
luchen.voice_design: 三十二岁左右的成年男性，音色低沉、沉稳，普通话标准，语速偏慢，克制冷静，几乎没有情绪起伏，句尾干脆利落。
luchen.voice_sample: 有些事情你不需要知道，你只需要相信我。今晚跟着我走，别回头，也别出声。
luchen.hair: short black hair neatly swept back, light stubble
luchen.costume: a black two-piece slim suit, white shirt with an open collar and no tie, black leather oxford shoes, no jewellery

penthouse.name: penthouse living room
penthouse.look: a luxury penthouse living room at night with floor-to-ceiling windows showing the glittering Shanghai skyline with the Lujiazui towers, including the Oriental Pearl Tower, across the Huangpu River, low warm brass table lamps, a dark grey marble floor, a charcoal velvet sofa, and a dark wooden doorway on the right leading into shadow.
penthouse.keep: the floor-to-ceiling windows, the Shanghai Lujiazui night skyline, the brass table lamps, the dark grey marble floor, the charcoal velvet sofa and the doorway position

clips.summary: At night in {loc}, {linxia} turns from the window to face {luchen}, who steps out of the dark doorway. She tells him she believed he was dead for three years; he answers that the man she married is gone.
clips.soundscape: Quiet penthouse room tone continues throughout, with a faint muffled city hum through the glass and a soft electrical buzz from the lamps.

cuts.composition: Vertical rule-of-thirds frame: {linxia} stands in the left third in front of the floor-to-ceiling window with the skyline behind her, while {luchen} stands half in shadow in the doorway in the right background of {loc}.
cuts.action: {linxia}, holding {wine_glass} low in her right hand, slowly turns from the window toward the doorway, the satin gown catching the lamplight. {luchen} takes one measured step out of the shadow into the warm lamplight.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude, at slow speed.
cuts.sound: Her heel clicks once on the marble; his single footstep follows.
cuts.end: Both hold still, eyes locked across the room.

cuts.speaker: linxia
cuts.line: 整整三年，我以为你死了。
cuts.delivery: low and trembling, holding back anger and tears
cuts.composition: Tight close-up with her face in the right two-thirds of the frame, warm lamp key light from screen left, cool blue skyline bokeh behind her.
cuts.action: Her eyes glisten with tears that do not fall; her fingers tighten around the stem of {wine_glass} at the bottom edge of the frame, and her jaw tightens just before she speaks.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.
cuts.end: She keeps staring at him, lips pressed together.

cuts.speaker: luchen
cuts.composition: Her bare shoulder and the edge of her wavy dark hair blur in the left foreground; he faces the camera in the right third, lit by the warm lamp with the dark doorway behind him.
cuts.action: He holds her gaze without blinking; a faint muscle moves in his jaw.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on his eyes.

cuts.speaker: luchen
cuts.line: 你嫁的那个人，回不来了。
cuts.delivery: low and flat, as a final statement
cuts.composition: Tight close-up with his face in the left two-thirds of the frame, lamp light raking across the scar on his left eyebrow, the doorway falling to black behind him.
cuts.action: He lowers his eyes for a moment, then lifts them back to her.
cuts.camera: Very slow push in, with small amplitude, at slow speed.
cuts.end: He stays perfectly still as the line ends.

clips.summary: Moments later in {loc}, {linxia} closes the distance to {luchen} and demands to know who he is; he says he is the only one who can keep her alive tonight, and her inner voice concludes he did not come back for her.
clips.soundscape: The same quiet penthouse room tone and muffled city hum continue throughout, with soft fabric rustle as she moves.

cuts.composition: Profile two-shot in front of the window: {linxia} on the left, {luchen} on the right, the skyline glittering between them.
cuts.action: {linxia} closes the distance with two sharp steps and stops one step from him; he does not move back.
cuts.camera: Slow lateral track to the right, with small amplitude, at slow speed.
cuts.sound: Two quick heel clicks on the marble.
cuts.end: They stand face to face, one step apart.

cuts.speaker: linxia
cuts.composition: His black-suited shoulder and the back of his swept-back hair blur in the right foreground; she faces the camera in the left third, the window skyline soft behind her.
cuts.action: She lifts her chin and searches his face, her breath unsteady.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on her eyes.

cuts.speaker: luchen
cuts.line: 今晚唯一能让你活下来的人。
cuts.delivery: quiet and urgent, every word deliberate
cuts.composition: Tight close-up, his face filling the centre-left of the frame, warm lamp light on one side and cool skyline light on the other.
cuts.action: He leans in a few centimetres; his eyes flick once toward the door, then back to her.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: linxia
cuts.delivery: cold and certain, barely above a whisper
cuts.composition: Close-up of {linxia} in three-quarter profile, lamplight on her cheek, the skyline a soft blue blur behind her.
cuts.action: A single tear finally slides down her cheek; she does not wipe it away.
cuts.end: The shot ends on her eyes in extreme close-up, the tear catching the light.

wine_glass.name: crystal wine glass
wine_glass.look: a tall, thin-stemmed crystal Bordeaux glass, one-third filled with dark red wine, no markings.
wine_glass.keep: the tall thin stem, clear crystal bowl and the one-third fill of dark red wine
